items.text: Ayman al Zawahiri's death is a win for America. Many will go to sleep tonight with the peace of mind that this dangerous man is no longer a threat. I applaud the brave Americans who had a hand in this operation. This was a job well done! #FL02 #JusticeServed

State NIL regulations are well-intentioned & meant to promote fair treatment of student athletes. However, we need safeguards. Congress must act to promote a fair nationwide NIL landscape that is transparent & benefits ALL athletes. #FL02 @HouseCommerce

Did you know there is no one-size-fits-all treatment approach when it comes to Parkinson’s & no two people have the same symptoms. 
This #ParkinsonsAwarenessMonth, I encourage you to learn more about how we can support the Parkinson’s community. #YourDoctorOnTheHill #FL02
Let’s prioritize taking care of our mental well-being. During #MentalHealthAwarenessWeek, let's work together to end the stigma and promote mental wellness.  #FL02

When preparing for #hurricaneseason, don’t forget to keep all important personal documents in a cloud-based system, safe, or waterproof location. Some of these documents might include ID cards, birth certificates, social security cards, and insurance policies. #BePrepared #FL02

Chinese healthcare professionals participating in organ harvesting are committing crimes against humanity. The State Dept. must take action to ensure these criminals do not have access to immigration status in the U.S. Read more here: https://t.co/25KwDAgYln #FL02

I had a great lunch with David Altmaier, the former Florida Insurance Commissioner! It was an excellent opportunity to discuss what Congress can do to improve the National Flood Insurance Program. #FL02 https://t.co/M7zcZxrKnF

Since the @NCAA is overturning decisions, Darrell Jackson of @FSUFootball better be next! You can’t give a player special treatment & expect us all to overlook the double standard. #LetDarrellPlay #FL02 https://t.co/hGmatxWDnQ

This morning, I joined hotel & small business owners at the Heart of House meeting at Comfort Inn & Suites in Panama City. We had a great discussion about temporary worker visa reform, labor shortages, and skyrocketing insurance rates. Thank you all for having me! #FL02 https://t.co/Apl8Wpx1fR

Thank you to everyone who joined me at last night’s @AMACforAmerica roundtable! I appreciated our discussion about the debt, our border crisis, Medicare, and social security. #FL02 https://t.co/pbDjtJZn3d

I love supporting small business owners like Dave Trepanier who owns American Charlie Grill & Tavern! We had a great conversation about local tourism trends, legal immigration issues related to the H-2B visa process, & insurance issues impacting small business owners. #FL02 https://t.co/lNv94t8hJJ

Thank you, CAUSEway Car Show, for inviting Team Dunn to your event! Raising money for children going through cancer treatment is such a worthy cause and we were honored to attend. #FL02 https://t.co/IuV5y64KyZ

The @HouseCommerce’s Health Subcommittee included my bill the PROTECT Rare Act in a legislative hearing today!  It’s critical that rare disease patients have access to proven treatments, including the off-label uses of drugs when appropriate.

The Continuing Appropriations package passed, which included $800K for the restoration of Fords Arm of Lake Jackson. The project provides a combination of water quality treatment & flow improvements in the basins south & east of Fords Arm. Congrats! #FL02

Today is #NationalImmuneSystemDay. Here are some quick tips to improve your immune system:

✅Eat Well
✅Stay Active
✅Get Enough Sleep
✅Think Positively
✅And of course, wash your hands

Our youth’s mental health is worse than ever, especially after the destructive COVID-19 lockdowns. Protecting our youth is too important to be limited by a Medicaid billing restriction. My latest bill aims to fix that.

I enjoyed my visit last week with @DMHHospital Interim CEO Rohan Anderson & their Board of Trustees.  

During COVID, they led the charge with innovative treatment options when no other facility would. I continue to be thankful for their commitment to serving our community! #FL02 https://t.co/UFqDKAqBci

I’m thrilled to announce that my bill, the FIND Act, passed the @HouseCommerce Subcommittee on Health.

This legislation will help patients gain early access to life-saving scans for prostate cancer and many other conditions. We’re one step closer to signing this into law! https://t.co/zkzCv5EnCG

Govt assurance labs would put big tech in control of market entry for the smaller innovators they compete with. HHS needs to work with Congress on solutions that do not jeopardize AI’s potential benefit to our healthcare system before it is realized.

I am incredibly proud that the House has overwhelmingly passed the Senator Elizabeth Dole 21st Century Veterans Healthcare & Benefits Improvement Act!

Veterans have upheld their oaths to our country. Now, Congress is doing its part to uphold our promises to them.

Congratulations to my friend and colleague @RepGuthrie for being named Chair of the @HouseCommerce Committee. I look forward to working with you to find innovative solutions to improve healthcare and energy. Well deserved!

🚨NEW BILL ALERT 🚨 Today, I introduced the PSA Screening for HIM Act to require health insurance companies to cover preventative prostate cancer screenings.

I’m proud to have bipartisan support from @RepGregMurphy, @RepYvetteClarke, and @RepTroyCarter in our mission to keep American men healthy!
